account.nopublicurl: Passkeys need the panel's address in WMANAGER_PUBLIC_URL.
account.passkeystext: A passkey (a security key, Windows Hello, a phone) can be given instead of the code at sign-in. The code from the app and the recovery codes keep working.
account.signshow: Type this code into wmanager-sign; it works once, until %s:
account.signstale: For your safety, sign in again before connecting wmanager-sign.
account.signtext: wmanager-sign is the program in which you sign what the computers act on, with your security key. To connect it to this server, make a code here and type it into wmanager-sign.
account.signwarn: Never give this code to anyone, not even someone who says they are from support: it connects their wmanager-sign to your account.
account.title: Account
admin.link: Give this one-time link to %s yourself, in a way you trust. It works once, for 7 days, and is shown only now:
admin.name: Name
admin.title: Server
audit.title: Audit log
audit.whole: The chain is whole: %d entries, head %s.
code.label: Code
code.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
code.title: Second factor
company.chainbroken: The stored admin lists don't check, so the computers would refuse them: %s
company.fingerprint: The company's fingerprint (compare it with the one written down when the company was made):
company.newtoken: The new token, shown only now:
company.newtokenwarn: Give it only to whoever installs the computers, as you would the USB drive with the installer.
company.nochain: No admin list yet: an administrator makes the first one in wmanager-sign.
company.tokenlimits: A token is valid for 1 to 30 days, for 1 to 1000 computers.
company.tokenstext: An installer carries a token, or a person types it at a computer. Each computer enrolled uses it once. A computer enrolled is in no group until a signed state lists it.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again later.
error.locked: Too many wrong codes: the account is locked for a while. A recovery code still works.
error.lockedsetup: Too many wrong codes: the account is locked for a while. Try again later.
error.notpending: This account is set up already.
error.session: The sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
error.setup: This link doesn't work: it was used, it expired or it is wrong. Ask the owner of the server for a new one.
error.toomany: Too many attempts from this address. Try again in a minute.
error.weak: A password needs at least 12 characters.
home.none: You don't belong to any company yet.
home.title: Companies
passkey.failed: The passkey didn't work. Try again, or enter a code.
passkey.stale: For your safety, sign in again before adding a passkey.
password.title: Set your password
recovery.text: Keep these codes somewhere safe, apart from your phone. Each one works once instead of a code from the app, also while the account is locked. They are shown only now.
recovery.title: Recovery codes
signin.title: Sign in
totp.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.secret: Or type this key into the app:
